title: Kissed Binchotan Jamaican Sausages Frittata
description: A paleo-friendly, meal-prep Jamaican dish featuring Italian fennel sausages, Binchotan-charcoal, served in a fondue-pot. Perfect for a quick and flavorful breakfast or lunch.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a fondue-pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped cilantro leaves and cook for 1 minute, until wilted.
Add the Italian fennel sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the mustard seeds, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
Pour the eggs over the sausage mixture and cook until the eggs start to set, about 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the fondue-pot to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the eggs are set and the frittata is golden brown.
Remove the fondue-pot from the oven and garnish with shredded coconut and chopped parsley, if desired.
Serve the frittata hot, straight from the fondue-pot.
Let the frittata rest for a minute or two before slicing and serving.
